answers.rationale: The requirement specifies features for metal-clad switchgear, including hinged, latched rear doors and drawout carriages with grounding devices. The CROWN-ARMV product is described as arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear, which aligns with the requirement for metal-clad switchgear.

The requirement specifies Kirk Key Interlock for incoming feeder cubicles, a feature typically associated with metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is suitable as it is designed for such applications.
The requirement specifies a copper main bus with specific ratings and standards compliance, which is a feature of the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
The requirement specifies insulated medium voltage bus with epoxy and removable access covers, which are features of the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
The requirement specifies that the voltage ratings of the main bus shall equal the breaker ratings, a standard feature of the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
The requirement specifies four-hole NEMA pads for high-voltage power cables, which are accessories available in the CROWN-ACC product catalog.
The requirement specifies a comprehensive grounding system for the switchgear, which is a feature of the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
The requirement specifies phase sequence identification, BIL rating, and voltage/current ratings, all of which are features of the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
